title: Diffusion-Induced Spatial Attention Overlapping Community Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.26737v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Detection of overlapping communities is essential for modelling networks in which nodes participate simultaneously in multiple structural or functional groups. Existing graph neural network approaches commonly rely on local message passing, which can obscure community boundaries through smoothing and limit the representation of structurally relevant long-range dependencies. We introduce Diffusion-Induced Spatial Attention Community Detection (DISCO), a deep-learning framework that combines a structural prior derived from influence spreading dynamics, sparse multi-head attention, and non-negative community-affiliation learning. The prior identifies candidate interactions beyond immediate graph neighbours and biases attention according to their structural proximity, while a Bernoulli-Poisson edge-reconstruction objective enables overlapping community inference from node attributes and structural profiles, or both. translated_title: 扩散诱导空间注意力重叠社区检测
translated_abstract: 重叠社区检测对于建模节点同时参与多个结构或功能群体的网络至关重要。现有的图神经网络方法通常依赖局部消息传递，这可能通过平滑作用模糊社区边界，并限制对结构相关长程依赖关系的表示能力。我们提出了扩散诱导空间注意力社区检测（DISCO），这是一个深度学习框架，它结合了从影响力传播动力学中导出的结构先验、稀疏多头注意力以及非负社区归属学习。该先验能够识别直接图邻居之外的候选交互，并根据其结构接近度对注意力进行偏置；同时，伯努利-泊松边重构目标使得模型能够从节点属性、结构特征或两者兼有的信息中推断重叠社区。基准实验（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出DISCO深度学习框架，利用扩散传播动力学构建结构先验，结合稀疏多头注意力与非负社区归属学习，突破局部消息传递的局限，实现更准确的重叠社区检测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DISCO, a deep learning framework that combines a diffusion-based structural prior, sparse multi-head attention, and non-negative community-affiliation learning to overcome the limitations of local message passing for more accurate overlapping community detection.
